_meta.description: Tenders and contract packages for Line 6. Values in crore INR. 'tender_status' is floated, bids_opened, awarded, cancelled or unknown. Only packages whose source was read are listed; track packages (CT-38 rails, MT-08, MT-09R, MT-13) and AFC (CA-238) wait for a source read in full.

tenders.scope: Viaduct and 5 stations, Swami Samarth Nagar to Shyam Nagar, 6.079 km
tenders.notes: Award month from The Metro Rail Guy's line page; the package report names the J Kumar-CRTG JV. No value was read.

tenders.scope: Viaduct and 5 stations, Mahakali Caves to Powai Lake (Shyam Nagar to IIT Powai, 4.329 km)
Viaduct and 3 stations, IIT Powai to Vikhroli (EEH), 4.771 km, with the ramp to the depot entry

tenders.notes: Notice of 13 Jun 2023 (MMRDA, https://mmrda.maharashtra.gov.in/sites/default/files/2023-06/NIT%20for%20Line%206%20Rolling%20Stock%20Tender.pdf); cancelled on 18 Oct 2023 after 13 corrigenda. Signalling, telecom and platform screen doors had their own tender (notice of 28 Apr 2023), also folded into CA-232.
Two bids: Sam India Rs 547.45 crore, Ahluwalia Contracts Rs 608.28 crore. 30 months in the tender. Work waits for the land (Lokshahi, Aug 2026).

tenders.scope: Trains (18 of 6 cars), CBTC signalling and train control, telecom, platform screen doors, depot machinery, with maintenance
tenders.notes: Tender 2024_MMRDA_992244_1, re-invited Feb 2024 (MMRDA corrigendum 1, https://mmrda.maharashtra.gov.in/sites/default/files/2024-02/corrigendum_1.pdf: 15 years of maintenance after 2 years of defect liability). MMRDA's corrigendum 9 of 30 Sep 2024 (https://mmrda.maharashtra.gov.in/sites/default/files/2024-10/corrigendum_09.pdf) names it with 5 years of maintenance after 2. Estimate and the Rs 2,269.66 crore value from The Metro Rail Guy; NBM gives about Rs 2,269 crore without GST, July 2025. Titagarh builds the trains for NCC.

tenders.scope: Power supply and traction, E&M, lifts and escalators, with maintenance
tenders.notes: Rs 642.44 crore (NBM, Metro Rail News, letter of acceptance of 18 Jul 2025); The Metro Rail Guy gives Rs 668.15 crore. Tender 2024_MMRDA_993151_1 (MMRDA notices, 2024).
